reviews.title: WORST AIRLINE EVER!!!
reviews.text: I made a reservation for 9am and have a connecting flight in DR. Sunrise called and said they moved me to the 11am flight. I agreed to change my connection to a later time while having to pay a fee. The night before my flight, Sunrise called to say they moved me to the 1PM flight. I advised them that I would miss my connection and the representative said to send an e-mail and they will respond within 48 hours (after the time I’m supposed to travel). My seat was given to someone else and now I must absord the cost of sleeping in DR and also the fee for changing my connecting flight. If you value your sanity at all, STAY AWAY FROM THIS AIRLINE!!!
reviews.author: Abeac

reviews.title: Opportunist, scammers, thieves
reviews.text: Sunrise airways is trying to make a maximum profit of the situation of the country. Since ground travel is a risk to get robbed or kidnapped by gangs before you even get to your destination, Flying is the only way to get to your destination safely and Sunrise is the only airline you can travel with. Everyday there is an increase on the ticket price. On March18th 2022: Sunrise Paup- cayes round trip :245USD FLIGHT TIME : 30 MNS >> local Spirit Paup- frt Lauderdale :204 USD>>>international FLIGHT TIME: 2hr You should be ashamed of yourself for taking advantage of situation like this. Disgusting.
reviews.author: Robenson L

reviews.title: Do not trust this company
reviews.text: I bought a ticket from this company at 23 th November 2019 and they charged the full amount at the same time from my credit card. After that they send me an message which is informed me that the flights will be cancelled at the 15 th Dec. 2019 (before the COVID) but they will refund my amount to my card. Till this day, (05 May 2020) I have several times sending to them messages but there is no answer, If I call them, they are saying ; yes sir, we will send your money back but never happening. Over than five months which they charged from me but not refunding. A friendly offering to anybody who is looking to buy a ticket from them, Please do a favour for yourself, and think twice before buying a ticket from them, Because If your flight will be cancelled with any of the reason which is sourced from them, this means your money will be burned like me. I am waiting over than 5 months and they are not replying me and nothing turned to my credit card. I will never trust this company and never suggesting to any of my friend because it is a very dangerous company, they can unexpectedly cancel the flight and do not want to reply or refund. They never offered me that we are sorry sir, we cancelled your flight, If you need an assitance we may try to find you another ticket from another company etc.etc. nothing. Their only policiy is just silence..... My PNR confirmation code is 0036IK. This was an real ticket.
reviews.author: Joseph O

reviews.title: Great Decision!!
reviews.text: On a plane somewhere on a monthly basis, I am glad I found Sunrise Airways for my travels to Santo Domingo from Havana Cuba. It's an excellent choice friendly and safe. I highly recommend to everyone.
reviews.author: John G

reviews.title: Always a problem
reviews.text: Always some kind of issue with this company. They send an email saying the flight will be an hour earlier but nobody at the airport is aware. Stay away from this outfit if you can.
reviews.author: Luc

reviews.title: Fastest and cheapest option to have a direct flight to the main Caribbean Islands
reviews.text: Travelling within the Caribbean islands could be both time and budget consuming; specifically when not willing to have a long transit (5 hours or more) via Miami. Sunrise is the fastest, cheapest and more reliable option I found for my trip from Port-au-Prince (Haiti) to Willemstad (Curacao). Fastest because it’s a one hour and half or even less time of flight compared to offers of 10 to 12 hours with multiple transits through Miami and other islands. Cheapest because of the flight tickets’ prices of other companies operating in the regions. That’s for the pros aspects but this option do have some cons: yes, you can have delays (I traveled a lot with this company but never had a cancelled flight) and yes you can expect more comfortable planes for the price. The best of all is that when you arrive in Willemstad (Curacao), the island is so beautiful and people so welcoming that you forget the delays and the uncomfortable (but short trip). The company should definitely better organise its leasing plan of planes and choose quality planes to be sure that it capture quality and loyal clients like me. I recommend this company if you want a short and direct flight between Caribbean islands.
reviews.author: Brouz C

reviews.title: confusing to do business with
reviews.text: very difficult to even find info about airline and then no one seemed to be able to give us any information we asked for concerning luggage when we did get the tickets via email they had the wrong departure and arrival times printed on them which was a real mix up for those picking us up in pap
reviews.author: TrailBlazer242858

reviews.title: Quick hop to Dominican Republic
reviews.text: I was booked to go on a Sunday morning. They called me personally at noon on Saturday to advise the flight would be cancelled, and offered to re-book me either Saturday night or Sunday night. I chose Saturday night, and the plane left on time. It is only about a 40 minute flight which was smooth and good views of the countryside. I came back the following Tuesday. That flight was delayed a couple hours, and I should have called to confirm departure time before leaving for the airport. The couple hours went by and then I flew back. Again a smooth flight. They might have tried to call me to advise of the delay, but I don't know if my Haitian phone could receive a call in the DR. Staff and pilots were pleasant and professional. My only advice is to verify the flights before going to airport. PAP airport has lots to see and do, but the DR airport is a little sparse although you can get some basic food and drinks, but that is all because this is not the big international airport.
reviews.author: Rich P

reviews.title: Ruined our vacation.
reviews.text: Flight was canceled at last minute. We were kept waiting for 2 days without information about what was going to happen. When we asked to have the days lost, added to our trip, so we could stay a few more days, we did not even get an answer. Departure was delayed, treatment on Haiti could improve a lot. On return, same story, delays, delays, delays. No food or drink available at the airport... Sorry, I shiver when only hearing the name Sunrise, Airways...
reviews.author: Mightymike1966

reviews.title: Horrible airline
reviews.text: Do not book with Sunrise Airways. We had a 2,5h delay on our inbound flight and a 3,5h delay on our outbound flight. They made us wait at the check in counter for over 1,5h and didn't tell us anything. Eventually they told us that the new estimated time of departure would be 2 am.... They didn't compensate anything!
reviews.author: Maxime K

reviews.title: I would not recommend Sunrise Airways
reviews.text: My experience with Sunrise was terrible. They cancelled my flight 60 minutes prior to departure without advanced notice. They did not apologize or reimburse me for the fare. I would not recommend anyone to fly with sunrise unless they’re the only option. Because if they don’t have enough passenger for flight, they’ll cancel it at the last minute
reviews.author: Mess5588

reviews.title: Nervous flyer but sharp crew!
reviews.text: First time on a Beechcraft 1900 and not a fan of flying to begin with, crew were smart to respond quickly and calmly to my nervousness and afford me a wonderful experience including a flyby of the world class Citadelle. This is a busy commuter flight and seats are not assigned. As such I recommend queuing up at the door a bit early and sitting on the left side of the plane. If you have noise cancelling headphones, use them, it gets loud.
reviews.author: James M

reviews.title: Getting from Port-au-Prince to Cap Haitien... the quick way
reviews.text: Sunrise has several flights per day to and from Cap. The flights are typically on time (except when the weather is rough) and take about 25 minutes. Driving takes six hours or more... even on a good day.
reviews.author: andrewwatson2018

reviews.title: Cancelled Last-Minute; No Refund
reviews.text: My flight on this airline was cancelled only two hours before it was meant to depart, meaning that I was given no warning. It was not rescheduled but simply cancelled, meaning that I couldn't take an alternate route and ended up paying hundreds of dollars for the non-refundable hotel and tour options I'd already booked. Fine - that happens. But they also have been completely nonresponsive to email requests for a refund, and I've had to open a dispute on the payment with my credit card company. Absolutely not an airline I would ever recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: sp12363

reviews.title: Smooth flight
reviews.text: This is my fifth time flying with Sunrise Airways to travel between Haiti and the Dominican Republic. I was glad that the flight was on time (Sunrise flights mostly are, but I did have one prior experience where the flight was delayed for mechanical reasons) and very smooth. There were no turbulence. We had a full flight of 19 passengers and everyone landed in the JBQ airport on time. As this is a short flight on a small plane, it was pretty bare bones, but all the essentials (i.e. safety, speed, punctuality) were accounted for. Leg room and seat comfort isn't something one can expect, but all in all, I have nothing to complain about.
reviews.author: Julie L

reviews.title: Excellent and very good views
reviews.text: Small plane - 20 seats - and a bit bumpy as they don't fly very high. But only 25 minutes anyway. Pilot (a friend of our tour organiser) was helpful and reassuring. Leg room poor but didn't matter on such a short flight.
reviews.author: Oliverjulian

reviews.title: very good airline
reviews.text: We used SUNRISE for a domestic trip in Haiti, from Port-au-Prince to Cap Haitien and back and then once more for an one-way trip from Havana to Port-au-Price. The first trip was perfect with a small airplane of 18 seats, feeling though totally safe and enjoying the view. Ground staff (no flying staff, only pilots) has been most polite and efficient. The Havana to Port-au-Prince trip was a nice adventure, may be not due to SUNRISE but to the ground staff at Havana airport (I do not know Sunrise's extent of responsibiity on this issue) : after having stayed on non-moving check-in queue for 30 minutes, the ground staff had the brilliant idea (and most original I should say) to call us alphabetically !!! What a party !!! They changed their mind soon after the experiment and you can imagine the next mess, when being asked to return to our original posiitons, on the initial queue ! Nervertheless, the flight was excellent and the flying staff perfect.
reviews.author: meropi2016
